try.doc:name: Try - Update and Send message to Queue

db:update.doc:name: Update user account_status
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE user_accounts SET account_status = 'INACTIVE', status_updated_on = CURRENT_DATE, alert_sent = 'YES' WHERE username = :username

ee:transform.doc:name: Response after UPDATE and Publish message

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "status": "Success", "message": vars.user.USERNAME ++ " account status is set to 'Inactive' as user has been inactive for over 60 days." }
